content:
evan: quick report: the Go generator quickstart hangs for me if I cancel the ctx during the initial handshake. minimal repro attached.

priya: which go-sdk and go versions?

evan: go 1.20, go-sdk v0.14.2. tiny repro below. After canceling the ctx the loop exits but gen.Close() blocks until the outer deadline. pprof shows goroutines stuck in auth retry/backoff. :frowning_face:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Second)
defer cancel()

gen := client.Generator("gpt-open")
for gen.Next(ctx) {
  fmt.Println(gen.Value().Text)
}
// expecting immediate return after cancel but Close blocks
if err := gen.Close(); err != nil {
  log.Printf("close err: %v", err)
}
```

priya: ack. sounds similar to other reports: handshake spawns background work (token refresh / retry) that doesn't observe the ctx from Next, so Close waits on that background worker.

dave: workaround in CI: cancel the ctx before calling Close, then call Close in a goroutine with a timeout. ugly but unblocks tests. example: `go func(){ c := time.After(500*time.Millisecond); select { case <-c: gen.Close() } }()`

evan: i posted a failing gist so folks can run `go test -run TestGeneratorCancel` locally: https://gist.github.com/evan/gen-cancel-repro. it reproduces with flaky auth backoff.

priya: proposed fixes: (1) thread the user-provided ctx into the handshake/token refresh so cancellation propagates; (2) add ctor overload/option to accept a handshake ctx (e.g., NewGenerator(ctx, opts...)) or a functional option `WithHandshakeCtx(ctx)`; (3) provide `Close(ctx)` so callers can bound how long they wait for graceful shutdown.

dave: +1 to Close(ctx). That makes shutdown predictable for apps. (Also add tests that fake token refresh delays and assert Close(ctx) returns promptly.)

docs-bot: created tracking doc entry: DE-2500 "go: generator handshake ignores iterator cancellation; Close blocks" — https://tracker/internal/DE-2500 :white_check_mark:

priya: scope: runtime needs to ensure token refresh honors ctx; sdk should expose handshake ctx option and a CloseWithContext helper. devex will update quickstart and sample app to show an explicit ctx at construction and demonstrate both iterator and callback patterns with cancel examples.

evan: small DX suggestion for quickstart: show the iterator example but also add a tiny note above it: "If your application cancels contexts during startup or auth refresh, prefer passing an explicit ctx at construction or use Close(ctx) to bound shutdown." New users keep tripping on this.

dave: i'll draft the runtime change and a unit test for tokensource respecting ctx. priya can author the SDK API patch.

ci-bot: referenced issues: DE-2431, DE-2460 in this thread. created DE-2500 as parent ticket.

priya: thanks all. i'll open a draft PR for `WithHandshakeCtx(ctx)` + `Close(ctx)` and add a migration note in the SDK changelog. once merged devex will update the sample app and onboarding docs.

evan: great — thanks for the quick triage! :raised_hands:
